title: Open-circuit temperature
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the thermistor temperature when S is open, yielding the final answer of 10°C.

title: Closed-circuit motor current
description: Important: Applies the motor's power equation (P = UI_motor - I_motor²r) to solve for the motor current.

title: Closed-circuit thermistor current
description: Important: Uses Kirchhoff's Current Law at the junction to find the current through the thermistor (I_t = I_2 - I_motor).

title: Closed-circuit thermistor resistance
description: Important: Correctly applies Ohm's Law to find the thermistor resistance (R_t2 = U / I_t) using the motor terminal voltage.

title: Closed-circuit temperature
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the thermistor temperature when S is closed, yielding the final answer of 50°C.

title: Motor terminal voltage
description: Important: Calculates the voltage across the motor using U = E - I_2 * R_0.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (Volts, Amps, Ohms, Watts, °C) throughout the solution.

title: Incorrect power formula
description: Pitfall: Uses the incorrect formula for motor power (e.g., P = I²R or P = UI) instead of P = UI_motor - I_motor²r.

title: Sign or current error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in Kirchhoff's law or misinterprets the relationship R_t = 70 - t.
